findings.evidence: `Parton/PDF/ChargeConjugation.lean:153` already names the zeroth moment of exactly this difference: `def valenceNumber (f : Pdf (Species Flavor)) (i : Flavor) (Q2 : ℝ) : ℝ := mellinMoment f 0 (.quark i) Q2 - mellinMoment f 0 (.antiquark i) Q2`. No `valenceDensity` exists: grep for `valenceDensity` in `EpsilonEridani/Particles/Parton` returns nothing.
findings.fix: Add `def valenceDensity (f : Pdf (Species Flavor)) (i : Flavor) (Q2 : ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => f (.quark i) x Q2 - f (.antiquark i) x Q2` next to `valenceNumber` in `Parton/PDF/ChargeConjugation.lean`, and state `CountingRuleHypothesis`, `hasLargeXExponent_valenceModelPdf` and `hasLargeXExponent_countingRuleModelPdf` as `PDF.HasLargeXExponent (PDF.valenceDensity f M.valenceQuark Q0) 2` etc.
findings.issue: The valence density `fun x => f (.quark i) x Q - f (.antiquark i) x Q` is inlined four times (lines 87-88, 91-93, 102-103, 178-179) and exists only inside the meson module, although it is a flavour-level notion with no meson content: `CountingRuleHypothesis` uses `M` only to select `M.valenceQuark`. Any other hadron (the PR cites NuclearPartonDistributions §3.3) must re-inline the same lambda, and each `HasLargeXExponent.congr` proof must match it literally.

findings.evidence: Line 325-326: `rw [mellinMoment, mellinMoment, mellinMoment, ← MeasureTheory.integral_add (hf.momentIntegrable n i Q2).integrableOn (hg.momentIntegrable n i Q2).integrableOn]` — `measurable` never appears. Mathlib's `MeasureTheory.integral_add` takes integrability, not a regularity bundle.
findings.fix: State it with the two integrability hypotheses actually needed, e.g. `lemma mellinMoment_add {n : ℕ} {i : ι} {Q2 : ℝ} (hf : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n * f i x Q2) (Set.Icc 0 1)) (hg : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n * g i x Q2) (Set.Icc 0 1))`, with the same proof; callers pass `(...).momentIntegrable n i Q2 |>.integrableOn`.
findings.issue: `mellinMoment_add (hf : Regularity f) (hg : Regularity g) (n i Q2)` assumes more than it uses: the proof (line 326) only invokes `hf.momentIntegrable n i Q2` and `hg.momentIntegrable n i Q2`, so the `measurable` field and the quantification over all `n, i, Q2` are unused. Every other moment lemma in this file (`mellinMoment_weight`, `mellinMoment_comap`, `mellinMoment_congr`) takes no bundle.

findings.evidence: grep for `HasLargeXExponent` across `code/` shows `hasLargeXExponent_one_sub_rpow` only at its declaration (LargeX.lean:132); lines 133-135 and 141-147 repeat the same `div_self (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (sub_pos.2 _) _).ne'` ratio argument.
findings.fix: Add `theorem hasLargeXExponent_mul {h : ℝ → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hh : Tendsto h (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 c)) : HasLargeXExponent (fun x => h x * (1 - x) ^ β) β`, then derive `hasLargeXExponent_one_sub_rpow` (h = 1) and `hasLargeXExponent_modelPdf` (h = x^a, via `.congr` on the indicator) from it.
findings.issue: `hasLargeXExponent_one_sub_rpow` and `hasLargeXExponent_modelPdf` (line 139) each prove the endpoint limit from scratch, and neither follows from the other; the general statement behind both — a function eventually equal to `h x * (1 - x)^β` with `h → c > 0` on `𝓝[<] 1` has exponent `β` — is missing. `hasLargeXExponent_one_sub_rpow` has no other use in the repo, so as it stands it is a special case with a duplicated proof rather than a corollary.

summary: The large-x exponent itself is stated at the right level (a bare function of the momentum fraction, scale- and hadron-free), but three pieces sit below it: the valence density is inlined in the meson module instead of being named beside the flavour-level `valenceNumber`, `mellinMoment_add` demands full `Regularity` bundles where only moment integrability is used, and the two power lemmas each re-derive a missing general multiplier lemma.
